design: Independent preregistered 48-world TWO vs frozen COMBO2 validation
interpretation: The frozen gate saves 18.6% inference time but cannot establish noninferiority within the preregistered +0.05 edge-error margin. It skips the second swarm too often for robust recovery.
next: EXP-002N4 conservative adaptive-breadth retuning on N3 worlds, followed by fresh validation.
